description: This file declares the LifecycleInterfaceConnector class, which manages lifecycle operations for applications, including launching, closing, terminating, and handling app state changes. It also defines an internal NotificationHandler class for event notifications related to app lifecycle state changes.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle operations and event notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles lifecycle state change notifications and forwards them to the parent LifecycleInterfaceConnector.
